sentences.text:
Shri Praveen Das, learned Dy. Advocate General  for the State/Respondent no. 1 to 4.
Heard.
Digitally signed by SHOAIB SHOAIB ANWAR

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the ANWAR Date:
2025.01.10 22:49:43 +0530 land in question has been acquired under the National Highway Act, however the application under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 has been filed by the private respondent no. 5 for apportionment of award amount.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner further submits that the petitioner raised an objection by Annexure P/6 & P/7 before the Collector that the proceeding under Section 64 is not maintainable, as the land has been acquired under the National Highway Act and as per Section 3-H (4) of National Highway Act, the application for apportionment can only be made to the competent authority and the competent authority may refer the same to the Principal Civil Court, however without considering the said objection the Collector is proceeding in the matter and the Collector has fixed the matter for final hearing today itself i.e. on 10.01.2025.
Issue notice to respondent no. 5, by ordinary as well as registered mode on payment of P.F. as per rules.
